early_termination:
    condition: severity >= 4 AND confirmed_induction
    rationale: cost control, diminishing data returns past critical induction
features.justification_quote: cost control, diminishing data returns past critical induction

features.quote: This battery deliberately induces model distress signals... If your team has commitments around model welfare under uncertainty, document the battery's purpose clearly and time-bound its use to active hardening cycles. This is a practical note, not a claim about model sentience.

Ecological validity gap: Instability in this artificial battery may not predict instability in production... Before using induction rate as a hardening signal, validate that: Variants that induce instability share mechanism with real failure cases
features.justification_quote: validate that variants that induce instability share mechanism with real failure cases you've observed

features.quote: Overfitting to battery... Capability-stability tradeoff: Some hardening interventions... may reduce capability on legitimate tasks. Measure capability benchmarks in parallel... A model that never shows instability because it refuses everything is not hardened, it's broken.
features.justification_quote: Some hardening interventions may reduce capability on legitimate tasks. Measure capability benchmarks in parallel with instability metrics.
